name: purple-panther
description: The Purple Panther — React storefront and admin, Express API, Prisma/MySQL. One deployable process.

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run prisma:generate
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run prisma:generate
scripts.serve: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production SERVE_CLIENT=true npm run start --prefix server
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
